subject: Bench SDK S3: daemon.py — embedded bench daemon lifecycle
description: bench/zonoid_bench/daemon.py — spawn/own/teardown an ISOLATED bench daemon so benches stop sharing the dev :8787. start(daemon_js, port=None, data_dir): pick a free port (default), subprocess Popen `node <daemon_js>` with env ORCH_PORT=<port> + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=<bench data dir> (daemon.js:39/42), poll GET /health until phase:ready (whitelisted through the 503 boot gate, daemon.js:332), return a bound client base_url. Read <ws>/.graph/daemon.port for discovery if needed. stop(): terminate the process cleanly. daemon_js source = repo root daemon.js by default (resolve relative to repo), parameterizable for an installed @zonoid/cli. Model-cache: point CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA at a bench dir but SHARE the embed/rerank model files (symlink) to avoid a cold reload (per design §8.1). Node required. Smoke: start → /health ready → stop. Commit on the attempt branch.

summary: Created bench/zonoid_bench/daemon.py (stdlib-only, Windows-safe): DaemonHandle dataclass + start() + stop(). start() picks a free port (never 8787) via bind(:0), spawns `node daemon.js` with ORCH_PORT + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA env vars, shares production model cache at $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/models via symlink (copy fallback on Windows), polls /health until phase:ready (120s timeout). stop() does terminate→wait→kill. Also added bench/zonoid_bench/__init__.py and smoke_daemon.py. Smoke PASSED on embeddable Python: port=53944 (not 8787), time-to-ready=0.6s, process exited cleanly. Commit db9dfce on orch/attempt/59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b-17.
